mapper.select: SELECT * FROM blog_friend_link WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, link_id ASC
mapper.sql: SELECT f.link_id, f.link_name, f.url, f.avatar, f.description, f.sort_order, f.status, f.create_time, f.update_time, f.source, u.user_id AS joined_user_id, u.nickname AS joined_nickname FROM blog_friend_link f LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = f.applicant_id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM blog_friend_link WHERE link_id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_friend_link ( applicant_id, source, link_name, url, avatar, description, sort_order, status ) VALUES ( #{applicantId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{source}, #{link.linkName}, #{link.url}, #{link.avatar}, #{link.description}, #{link.sortOrder}, #{link.status} )
INSERT INTO blog_friend_link_quota (user_id, submission_date, submission_count) VALUES (#{userId}, #{date}, #{count}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE submission_date = #{date}, submission_count = #{count}
mapper.update: UPDATE blog_friend_link SET link_name = #{link.linkName}, url = #{link.url}, avatar = #{link.avatar}, description = #{link.description}, sort_order = #{link.sortOrder}, applicant_id = #{applicantId,jdbcType=BIGINT} WHERE link_id = #{link.linkId}
